prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL square 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR complete miniature wooden marionette poses with props, isolated on TRUE transparent background. No resemblance to a real person or existing fictional character. Fine short control strings above each hand/head ending WITHIN each quadrant; no cross-quadrant strings. Four fixed narrative poses: top-left puppet holds a small russet shopping tote at waist level; top-right puppet studies two large plain ochre coin discs in its hands; bottom-left puppet braces a forest-green shield with a clear checkmark in front; bottom-right puppet leans and bends its knees while gripping a compact heavy gray weight with one round lifting hole, visible effort in the body pose. All puppets shown HEAD TO TOE with no cropped strings, props, feet or fingers; joints and prop contact physically readable. Front three-quarter tabletop miniature lighting from upper left, original handmade theatrical model with real wood grain and cloth weave, not a human photograph, not a cartoon vector or plastic toy. Four independent complete poses within quadrants, generous transparent outer margins and at least 12 percent empty transparent central cross. Props large enough to recognize, no written text, numerals, symbols of currency, logos, signatures, stage scenery, hands of puppeteer, watermarks or extra figures. Conceptual miniature poses, not actual recorded puppetry footage.
scope: Original illustrative concepts, not real products, artifacts, manufacturing footage or physically validated builds
